questions: Did s-bend progress rise above 0.1496 at wheel_track 0.10 m, and did its max_error fall below 0.063 m?
Did steering_oscillation stay below 0.16 on all tracks? If it rose above 0.16, the Integrator should reduce kp before changing geometry.
Did the oval keep progress near 0.16 and rms_error near 0.020?
Did any track complete? If not, which track ends off track first, and at what progress?
Did slalom progress hold near 0.106, and did line-loss events stay at one per run?
feedback_request.what_to_report: Per track (oval, s-bend, slalom): completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, max_error, line_loss_events, steering_oscillation, control_effort, controller_errors. Also the kp that gave the best rms_error with this layout, and which sensors carry the most signal when the robot is on the line.

intent: Isolate the drivetrain effect on the iteration 7 platform. Keep seven contiguous 16 mm sensors at x = ±0.048 m and y = 0.08 m, mass 0.8 kg, radius 0.03 m and body 0.12 × 0.16 m. Change only wheel_track, from 0.12 m to 0.10 m, to raise turn rate on the s-bend and slalom. Expect s-bend progress above 0.15, oscillation below 0.16, and the oval unchanged.
learning: Iteration 7 showed that forward lead plateaued on the s-bend (0.1496 at y = 0.08 m vs 0.15 at 0.07 m), but the oval gained substantially (0.115 to 0.161). Iteration 8 tests only the track width at y = 0.08 m, since no drivetrain change has been tested with forward lead in place and the s-bend failure is still at max_error about 0.063 m.
rationale: Iteration 7 (y = 0.08 m) scored 57.50, up from 51.62 at y = 0.07 m. The gain came mostly from the oval, where progress rose from 0.115 to 0.161, rms_error fell from 0.030 to 0.020, and max_error stayed at 0.061 m. The s-bend was flat (progress 0.1496 vs 0.15, max_error 0.063 m, one line-loss event per run), and steering_oscillation stayed at 0.138, below the 0.16 trigger. Forward lead is therefore exhausted on the s-bend. Body width cannot help, since the off-track limit is max(0.06, 0.0125 + w/4), which is 0.06 m for every allowed width. Iteration 4 tested a 0.10 m track with 0.6 kg mass, but it was confounded with a 20 mm pitch that cut slalom progress, so the drivetrain effect has never been isolated. The Integrator's requested change is to test wheel_track 0.10 m with the sensing held fixed. I deviate from their revert to y = 0.07 m: the oval gain at 0.08 m is worth about 6 points of score and the s-bend has not been hurt. I keep y = 0.08 m and change only wheel_track from 0.12 m to 0.10 m, with mass held at 0.8 kg. This isolates the drivetrain against iteration 7. Expected result: the s-bend moves off its 0.15 plateau through a higher turn rate (max_error below 0.063 m, progress above 0.16), the oval holds near 0.16, and steering_oscillation stays below 0.16. If the s-bend and slalom are unchanged or worse, the next step is to revert to wheel_track 0.12 m and accept the current platform.
